name: Anisotropic Grid Resolution for Ray Traversal
aliases: Anisotropic Grid Resolution for Radiation Walk
definition: A technique to optimize the cost of a grid-based ray traversal (walk) by aligning voxel dimensions with the primary direction of ray travel, reducing the number of voxel steps required to traverse empty space.
summary: Anisotropic Grid Resolution optimizes ray traversal by aligning voxel dimensions with ray travel direction, reducing empty space steps by modifying the grid geometry rather than the traversal algorithm.
